# SSolutions

> Web studio from Novi Sad, Serbia. We build fast, modern websites, web apps, technical SEO and redesigns of existing sites. The site is in English and Serbian.

## Services
- Websites and landing pages
- Web apps and custom software (bookings, catalogues, admin panels)
- SEO and site speed
- Redesigns

## Work
- [Frizerski salon Stevan](https://frizerski-salon-stevan.vercel.app/): salon website
- [Ada Studio](https://adastudio.rs/): studio platform and CMS
- [Altara Inmo](https://www.altarainmo.com/): real-estate portal
- [Taxi Pro GPS](https://www.taxiprogps.com/): fleet tracking software

## Starting prices (EUR, excluding third-party costs)
- Landing page: from 350 €
- Business website (up to 5 pages): from 700 €
- Redesign: from 500 €
- Online shop: from 1,500 €
- Web application: from 3,000 €
- Maintenance: 30 €/month or 80 €/month
